title: Traditional Ukrainian Ackee Pilaf
description: A hearty and flavorful Ukrainian dish made with ackee and pilaf, perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: Heat the butter in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the pilaf and cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly toasted.
Add the chopped ackee, salt, and pepper. Stir well.
Add the quenched water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.
